job-information.label: Job information evidence
job-information.oneSubmissionNote: This is one task submission. One clear video can cover several information types and many equivalent ACs across the active units; it is not one photo per AC.

preferred.label: 1 short video
preferred.instruction: Show the job information you actually used and explain what you took from each source and how it affected today's work. Aim for about 1–3 minutes.

alternatives.label: If the information cannot be shown clearly on video
alternatives.instruction: Upload one document/photo set showing the relevant extracts, then add one short audio or written statement explaining the source, what you interpreted and how you used it.

capture: Select only the information sources genuinely used today.
For each selected source: say where it came from, what information you extracted, and how it changed or confirmed the work.
Do not include confidential project information unless it is permitted to be recorded.

practical.label: Practical task evidence
practical.oneSubmissionNote: One practical submission can support several performance and knowledge criteria when the video and short explanation genuinely demonstrate them.

preferred.label: 1 short practical video
preferred.instruction: Show yourself carrying out the key part of the task, the checks you make and the finished result. Briefly explain what you are doing and why.

alternatives.label: If video is not practical
alternatives.instruction: Use one 3-photo set (start, during, finish) plus one short audio or written statement explaining the method and checks.

capture: Show the task itself, not just the finished result.
Show at least one measurement, check or quality decision where relevant.
Explain any criterion that cannot be seen directly.

hidden-work.label: Hidden-detail evidence
hidden-work.oneSubmissionNote: Treat the photo set and short explanation as one task submission. The purpose is to prove work that will be covered up later.

preferred.label: 1 set of 3 photos
preferred.instruction: Take a clear photo before covering, one during installation and one showing the completed detail in context.

preferred.label: 1 short audio statement
preferred.instruction: Explain what the detail is, how it was positioned/installed and what checks you made before it was covered.

alternatives.label: Video alternative
alternatives.instruction: One clear video showing the detail before it is concealed can replace the photo set and audio if the learner explains the installation and checks in the same recording.

capture: Make the hidden detail clearly visible before it is covered.
Show position, fixing/bed/joint and any spacing or continuity requirement relevant to the task.
Include a wider view so the detail can be identified in the work.

knowledge.label: Knowledge evidence
knowledge.oneSubmissionNote: One concise statement can answer several repeated knowledge criteria. The learner does not need a separate statement for each equivalent AC.

preferred.label: 1 audio statement
preferred.instruction: Answer the task prompt in your own words and relate the answer to the work you are doing.

alternatives.label: Written alternative
alternatives.instruction: Use one written statement instead of audio. A short video explanation is also acceptable where it adds useful context.

capture: Answer the whole prompt, not just a yes/no response.
Use a real workplace example where possible.
The same response may satisfy equivalent criteria in several active units.

safety.label: Safety evidence
safety.oneSubmissionNote: Safety evidence should show the controls actually used on the task; it can support the repeated safety criteria across the active units.

preferred.label: 1 short safety video
preferred.instruction: Show the relevant controls in use and explain the main hazard, the control chosen and what would make you stop or change the work.

alternatives.label: Photo alternative
alternatives.instruction: Use up to 3 photos of the controls/work area plus one short audio or written explanation.

capture: Only claim PPE, RPE, LEV, access or other controls that are actually relevant and visible/explained.
Include changed conditions or reporting where the task requires it.

resources.label: Resources & tools evidence
resources.oneSubmissionNote: One resource-focused submission can cover several equivalent resource criteria when the learner identifies and explains the materials, tools or components actually used.

preferred.label: 1 clear photo
preferred.instruction: Show the materials, components, fixings or tools selected for the task.

preferred.label: 1 short audio statement
preferred.instruction: Explain why they are suitable, how you checked them and any limitation, defect or hazard relevant to the task.

alternatives.label: Video alternative
alternatives.instruction: One short video identifying the resources and explaining selection/checks can replace the photo and audio.

capture: Name the actual resource or tool used.
Link suitability and checks to the specification or task requirement.

quality.label: Quality-check evidence
quality.oneSubmissionNote: One quality-check submission can support repeated quality criteria across units when the check and result are clearly evidenced.

preferred.label: 1–3 photos
preferred.instruction: Show the completed work and the measurement/check used to confirm it meets the requirement.

preferred.label: 1 short audio statement
preferred.instruction: State what you checked, what tolerance/specification applied and what you would do if it was wrong.

alternatives.label: Video alternative
alternatives.instruction: One video showing the check and explaining the result can replace the photo and audio combination.

capture: Show the check, not only the finished work.
Record the outcome and any correction made.

programme.label: Programme & progress evidence
programme.oneSubmissionNote: Where the practical evidence already proves the work was completed, no extra visual evidence is needed; add one short explanation of time, progress or change.

preferred.label: 1 short audio statement
preferred.instruction: Explain the allocated time, progress against plan, any change that affected the work and who you told if a change was needed.

alternatives.label: Written or document alternative
alternatives.instruction: Use one written statement or a relevant programme/schedule extract with a short explanation.

capture: Give the estimated/allocated time where the criterion requires it.
State whether the task was completed within that time and explain any change.

communication.label: Communication evidence
communication.oneSubmissionNote: One verified example of real workplace communication can support several relationship/communication criteria when the people, purpose and outcome are clear.

preferred.label: 1 witness statement
preferred.instruction: A supervisor/employer confirms the communication or coordination that took place and what the learner contributed.

alternatives.label: Reflection alternative
alternatives.instruction: Use one short audio or written reflection describing who you communicated with, what information/advice was exchanged and the outcome.

capture: Identify who was involved and why the communication was needed.
Explain the information/advice given and the result.
Where a performance criterion requires real communication, verification is stronger than a generic statement.
